title: Book Two · Chapter 78: A Job for Four Hands
story:
At the end of summer, Mr Qiu needs a low shelf moved inside his doorway. His table still fits under the short roof. But rain can reach the school books there. He wants them farther inside.

Dad agrees to help on his free afternoon. Ronan comes with him. Mr Qiu clears the floor before they arrive.

“Can I lift this end?” Ronan asks.

Dad tests the shelf. “Not this one. It is too heavy.”

Mr Qiu comes to the other end. The two adults lift together. Ronan holds the door wide. The adults keep the shelf clear of the frame.

They set it down against the inside wall. Dad checks the feet. The shelf stands flat. It needs no repair.

Ronan holds the clean cloth. Mr Qiu asks him to wipe the empty lower space before the books go in. He works from the back toward the front. Dust makes a thin grey line along one corner.

“Can I put the books back?”

“These first,” Mr Qiu says.

He gives Ronan a small stack. Ronan carries it with both hands. He puts the books on the shelf. People can see the titles. The next stack is larger. He takes only half.

Dad checks the path beside the shelf. There is room for a customer with a bag. The doorway table stays clear at one end too. Mr Qiu sets a pencil tin on it, away from the edge.

“Does it need a sign?” Ronan asks.

“People can see the books. Let us try it first.”

A woman comes in to buy a notebook. Ronan steps away from the shelf. Mr Qiu finds the right size. The other books stay in their places. The woman leaves through the clear doorway.

Mr Qiu nods toward Dad. “That works.”

Dad checks the time. They finish that afternoon, as Dad promised. Mr Qiu writes the work in his book. He gives Dad the small payment they agreed on. Mr Qiu thanks Ronan for the clean shelf. Ronan has a drink of water.

On the way home, he looks at Dad's hands.

“No tools today.”

“Some jobs need lifting. Some need space.”

“And a cloth.”

“And a cloth,” Dad agrees.

At the green gate, Ronan takes Dad's work bag for the last few steps. It is lighter without the large tools. He puts it down carefully inside.

Mum is setting out supper. She asks if the shelf fits. Dad tells her about the first customer. Ronan adds the part about the notebook. Then he takes a cloth to their own low shelf. His red sail book is there. A little summer dust covers it.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

hold＝扶住；flat＝平放的；corner＝角。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan怎样参与工作而不碰工具？
2. Dad这次怎样按时交付？

## 读句子

**Ronan / holds / the clean cloth.** Ronan／拿着／干净的布。
